messages.subject: problems installing ebimage on unix
parts:
I think this may be the reason i'm unable to create the necessary png
files visualize the expression data. The package builds but fails
testing due to an undefined symbol:

installing to /usr/local/lib64/R/library/EBImage/libs

symbol: MagickCoreTerminus

ERROR: loading failed

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] problems installing ebimage on unix
parts:
On Wed, Dec 15, 2010 at 6:28 AM, kraman <krip...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> I think this may be the reason i'm unable to create the necessary png
> files visualize the expression data.

Yes, without EBImage you cannot produce the spatial PNG images for
ArrayExplorer.

Problems related to package of others, should be addressed elsewhere.
I saw your 'ebimage problems' post to R-help (Dec 15, 2010) and that
you've already been helped there.

/Henrik
